title: Team AI training in Payson, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop for Payson teams, delivered on their own tools and documents. $1,000 per person, 5-person minimum, travel included.
intro: Offices in Payson, whether a medical practice, a contractor, a school, or a real estate office, generally already have an AI tool included in the software they pay for. Microsoft 365 includes Copilot, Google Workspace includes Gemini, and Claude is available on its own. Those tools often go unused because nobody on staff has been shown how to apply them to the letters, estimates, reports, and spreadsheets the office produces every week. Team AI training addresses that gap directly.

Creosote Labs delivers the workshop in Payson, on site at the business or remotely, in the AI tool the team already uses. Participants work on their own computers with their own documents, produce real work during the session, and write down their own process as they go. The team receives a written guide, and a 30-day follow-up session is included. Pricing is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum and travel included; a program with 3 monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.
projects: A workshop for a medical office's front-desk and billing staff on drafting patient letters, prior authorization requests, and insurance correspondence in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
A session for a contractor's estimators and office manager on turning site notes into written proposals and change orders.
Training for a cabin rental or lodging team on answering guest inquiries and writing listing descriptions in Google Gemini.
A workshop for a real estate office on producing listing descriptions, market updates, and client emails from the office's own templates.
A session for a nonprofit or school office on grant narratives, newsletters, and board reports.

faqs.q: Does the team need any AI experience before the workshop?
faqs.a: No prior experience is needed. The day starts from the tool the team already has, such as Copilot, Gemini, or Claude, and each participant works on their own documents at their own pace.

faqs.q: What does training cost for a Payson team?
faqs.a: The workshop is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Travel to Payson is included. Larger teams are quoted, and the version with 3 monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.

faqs.q: What should the team have ready on the day?
faqs.a: Each participant needs their own computer with access to the company's AI tool, plus a few real documents they produce regularly, such as estimates, letters, or reports. We handle the rest.
